name: p2p3-pointer-aware-stop-e
note: The plain stop rule cut P2 search loops (5.1 to 3.9 requests) but lowered P3 recall (17/20 to 15/20) because it also stopped before following a pointer. This version stops only when the returned memory answers the request outright, and keeps following when that memory points at a place, an object or a person.

edits.find: and when a memory points to something else, such as a place or an object, search for that too.
edits.replace: and when a memory points to something else, such as a place or an object, search for that too. Stop searching once a search returns the memory that answers the request, unless that memory points at something else: follow the pointer once, then answer rather than rephrasing the same search.
